subject: Malaysia M-510 for Necarbo's coatings pigment portfolio
body:
Necarbo's coatings business combines pigment and resin distribution with application support from Beverwijk and a Londerzeel office.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS lists water-based wall paints and zirconium/aluminium surface treatment.

Could you direct this enquiry to Jos Van Buul for Necarbo's Londerzeel coatings business so I can provide the M-510 technical sheet?
